description: This file manages YouTube video data within an ERP system, including extracting video IDs from URLs, updating video statistics via the YouTube API, and scheduling periodic data refreshes.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: A Document class representing a YouTube video, with methods to validate and update its statistics.

methods.name: is_tracking_enabled
methods.description: Checks if YouTube tracking is enabled in settings.

methods.name: get_frequency
methods.description: Determines the update frequency in hours based on configuration.

methods.name: update_youtube_data
methods.description: Scheduled function to update YouTube video statistics based on configured frequency.

methods.name: get_formatted_ids
methods.description: Formats a list of videos into a comma-separated string of IDs for batch API requests.

methods.name: get_id_from_url
methods.description: Extracts the YouTube video ID from a URL.

methods.name: batch_update_youtube_data
methods.description: Fetches and updates statistics for multiple videos in batches.
